name: greeter
description: A minimal stateless HTTP service that returns a JSON greeting for a requested name via GET /hello?name=X, defaulting to a generic greeting when name is omitted. Follows app-factory-kaj/e2e-reference conventions: entrypoint at cmd/greeter/main.go with handlers delegating to internal/greeter, stdlib net/http only, PORT read from env (default 8080), and JSON errors shaped {"error": "message"}. It holds no persistence, no authentication, and no endpoints beyond /hello.
